featuredArticle.excerpt: 20 Harvestide, 1035 BF. Two days after the clinic, Waluigi had not left his room and the tape of the brothers' argument had played six times. Wario came in without knocking, read the notebook out loud, found a Star Festival coin taped to a notepad, and told the story of how he faked his own death after the Mario Kart Massacre. Then he reread the courier's note as greed instead of heroism - and the star stopped being lost and started being kept.

didYouKnow: ...that the Scorncrow told three separate filings it was not a monster, and when Remi Akamatsu finally tested the claim with a point-blank musket, the blood under the face was human?
...that Remi escaped two armed dungeon guards by drawing a goblin face on a cardboard box with a Sharpie marker and claiming to be a certified Box Guardian?
...that the Mount Ebott Survey Part VII file features Sans executing Flowey in a localized time-stop after recalling a midnight tea conversation with King Asgore?

editorialDirective.title: WAH! Editorial Directive — Time Filing Codes Are Now Mandatory:
editorialDirective.text: Eight filings say “30 Harvestide, 1040 BF” and not one of them says which came first. Waluigi is done guessing. Every new article now carries a filing code — TC:1040-08-30T23:50/SHD — year, month, day, the hour it happened, and which clock it happened on. The date you read stays in Waluigi's words. The code underneath it is checkable, and now something actually checks it. If you do not know the hour, you leave the hour off; you do NOT invent one. WAH!

fieldGallery.caption: The doorway, resolved: Hjumpik hauling Waluigi out by the sleeve while a second treant buds behind them.
After the compound rescue: Luigi's cap, clean bandages, and the note line that points toward the next arc.
The Scorncrow's mask knocked away — and a human face underneath it.
Inside the tree: the Skittering Grove, webbed boughs hung with wrapped shapes.
The grove at night: the Scorncrow's evil tree, bats at the roots, and Wario's stalled motorbike.
Eager's critical shortbow shot pins the Scorncrow at the feet.
A shambling mound eating the Overgrown Library, one volume at a time.
The red kitchen, where the cook's dinner makes the overgrowth wither.
Promo Mario's main stage — the clipping Waluigi is amending, loudly.
The Mario-shaped thing in the television, from the Revision 2 account.
Archie arrives on a thundercloud before the Tree of Woe.
The Dread Mansion corridor — the order nobody signed.
One object in an empty room: the axe, waiting, at the far end of the bridge.
Nine words, flatly placed: ‘Luigi... read it. Read the note. This changes everything.’
Empty blue overalls in the rubble — grinning with nobody inside.
